title: Chat Bridge Event v1
description: Platform-neutral agent-activity event produced by emitters (Claude Code hooks, OpenCode plugin) and consumed by chat adapters (Slack, Discord). Contract owner: Architect (ADR-0003). Additive optional fields keep schema_version 1; any breaking change requires event.v2.schema.json and schema_version 2.

schema_version.description: Major version of this contract. Consumers dead-letter unknown versions.

event_id.description: Opaque, deterministic UUID (lowercase, hyphenated). Idempotency key for the sender ledger. Derived from a content fingerprint so a re-fired hook or an echoed receipt yields the same id.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp set by the emitter.

origin.description: Where the event originated. 'local' = emitted by an agent runtime on this machine (F1/F2). 'slack' = reserved for F3 inbound-triggered runs.

hook.description: Native hook/event name that produced this event (e.g. PreToolUse, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, or an OpenCode plugin event name).

correlation_id.description: Opaque id grouping one orchestration run (Claude Code: hashed root session_id). F2 maps correlation_id -> thread_ts.

span_id.description: Optional opaque id of the unit of work inside the run (hashed tool_use_id / agent_id). Never the raw native id.

actor.description: Role whose identity posts the message. Must resolve in identities.json (roles or aliases); unknown values are normalized to 'unknown' by the emitter BEFORE spooling.

summary.description: Redacted, truncated plain text. Hard cap 2000 chars; effective cap comes from config.redaction.max_summary_chars (default 500). Never contains diffs or code blocks.

applied.description: Must be true: the spool never holds unredacted text.

summary_dropped.description: True when redaction failed closed and the summary was removed.

role.description: kebab-case role id (e.g. pm, backend, cavecrew-reviewer, unknown).

task_title.description: Redacted Task/Agent tool 'description' (short title). The prompt body is NEVER forwarded.

parent.description: Role that spawned this agent, when known.

verdict.description: Normalized verdict: pass = APPROVED/DONE/PASS; fail = CHANGES REQUESTED/NOT DONE/BLOCKED/FAIL.
